rows.en:
(Still, I'm happier just getting to have fun
with Klan-senpai like this.)

(Still, I'm happier just getting to have fun
with Klan-senpai like this.)

Let's see... If you pair it with this outfit,
wouldn't you look way more grown-up?
Hmm, hmm. I see.

(I've been going shopping with Klan-senpai
more and more often like this, but...)

(Am I actually any help to her
in becoming a grown woman?)

\p...
I owe you my thanks.

I'm truly grateful that you helped me
overcome these clumsy genes of mine.

Oh, come on...
I haven't done anything special.

Now, don't be so modest.
Besides, hanging out with you was fun.

Around you... I can be honest.
I think that's, how do I put it...
a really good thing...

So I'm super grateful to you.
Do you understand that?
Yes, I understand, Klan-senpai!

(If Klan-senpai feels that way,
maybe I was of some help after all?)
Mm, good.

Then, as thanks for everything,
shall we go eat at Nyan-Nyan?
My treat, of course.
Okay, I'll gladly take you up on that!
Right, then let's get going!
Okay. Oh, but...
Don't... eat my chashu today, okay?
rows.notes: Male. Chashu pork; refers to an earlier scene where Klan ate it.

rows.en:
As a grown woman, I'd never do
such a thing......
Please, I mean it, Klan-senpai.
rows.notes: Both genders. Player asks Klan (hontou ni tanomimasu yo).

rows.en:
(Having Klan-senpai thank me so formally
is kind of embarrassing...)

(Klan-senpai...
I'm the one who should be thanking you.
Let's keep getting along from here on.)
rows.notes: Both genders. kochira koso, kore kara mo yoroshiku.

rows.en:
(Am I actually any help to her
in becoming a grown woman?)

Oh, come on...
I haven't done anything special.

(If Klan-senpai feels that way,
maybe I was of some help after all?)
Don't... eat my chashu today, okay?

(Having Klan-senpai thank me so formally
is kind of embarrassing...)
Mm, that's about it for today's shopping.

I'm thirsty. Shall we go have tea
at Silver Moon or something?
Let's do that.
rows.notes: x13: player in many scenes (Klan, Luca, Michel, Pinon, Yui, scd_com_217), both genders. Generic agreement.

rows.en:
Going shopping with you like this,
and then enjoying tea afterward...

Maybe having ordinary days like this
just keep going is what happiness is.

I said it before, but let me say it again.
I'm counting on you from here on too!
\p!!
Same here. I'm counting on you too.

(I hope I can keep spending time
with Klan-senpai like this...)

(I hope I can keep spending time
with Klan-senpai like this...)

\p.
We're going shopping today.
Okay, Klan-senpai.
I hope they have clothes in my size...
rows.notes: Both genders. Klan is now an adult-size Micronian (c08087).

rows.en: Well, you do have a great figure, Senpai.

Don't flatter me like that.
You'll make me blush.
Still, it all worked out great, didn't it?

The clumsy genes that troubled you
are cured, and now you can micronize
and still stay grown-up...

That's right.
I never thought they'd actually be cured.

And thanks to that, I can walk
arm in arm with you like this...
What?! You had a dream like that?
rows.notes: Both genders. Reveals the preceding exchange was Klan's dream.

rows.en: Mm, it was quite a nice dream...

But someday I'll make it real,
not just a dream!

Go for it, Klan-senpai!
I'll support you too!
Mm!! I'm counting on you from here on too!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Klan (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_kln_009, the female branch that scene does not use; 'umeyou' = filler). Translated literally in the format of c04107/c06032.

rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Filler for Klan (male).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_kln_010, the unused male branch). As c08095.

rows.en:
Go for it, Klan-senpai!
I'll support you too!

(I came to Central Park, but there's
nothing much to do. I'm bored...)

Huh? Klan-senpai?
What are you doing here?

Hm? Why, if it isn't \p.
I was just out for a little walk.
rows.notes: x8: frd_kln_101/102, both genders; works for the park scenes.

rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Then how about we take a walk together......

Sorry, I was just about to head home.
I'll be taking my leave.
Oh, okay. See you...

(I finally ran into Klan-senpai, too...
Oh well, guess I'll head home as well.)

(I came to Central Park, but there's
nothing much to do. I'm bored...)

(I finally ran into Klan-senpai, too...
Oh well, I guess I'll head home as well.)

uncertain: c08081-c08094 (frd_kln_009 male, frd_kln_010 female): the exchange about her cured genes turns out to be Klan's dream (c08090 'You had a dream like that?'). Translated straight; whether the earlier lines are staged as the dream or as Klan recounting it is not visible in the text.
c08095/c08096: developer placeholders under Alto's plate, translated literally in the format earlier slices used (c04107, c06032).
c08062/c08070 chashu: refers to an earlier scene in which Klan ate the player's chashu (not in my slices).
c08066 kochira koso ... yoroshiku rendered as thanks back plus 'Let's keep getting along from here on.'
